title: Photo of Jolly West on the set of 2001

tellings.quote: you have, you know, a picture of Jolly West on the set of 2001

plain: There is said to be a photograph of the psychiatrist Jolly West on the set of 2001: A Space Odyssey, the space film shot in the 1960s. Michels brings it up in passing while talking with his guest, crediting the point to another podcaster named Danny Jones. He raises it because it would tie a man linked to the intelligence world to one of the great films about contact with something beyond Earth.
